name: Lemon Curd
notes: Lemon Curd can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. You can easily double the recipe and freeze half of it in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag. Thaw in the refrigerator, and use within 1 week of thawing.

items: ⅔ cup fresh lemon juice (about 3 large lemons)

steps.title: Cook the eggs and sugar
steps.body: Combine in saucepan over medium heat, stirring with a whisk: **¾ cup sugar**, **1 Tbsp grated lemon rind** and **2 large eggs**. Cook til sugar dissolves and mixture is light in color (about 3 minutes).

steps.title: Add juice and butter
steps.body: Stir in: **⅔ cup fresh lemon juice (about 3 large lemons)** and **2 Tbsp butter or stick margarine**.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.body: Cook for 5 minutes or until mixture thinly coats the back of a spoon, stirring constantly with a whisk.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Cool. Cover and chill (the mixture will thicken as it cools).
